name: Common Snapping Turtle
description:
The common snapping turtle (*Chelydra serpentina*) is a large freshwater turtle of the family Chelydridae. Its natural range extends from southeastern Canada, southwest to the edge of the Rocky Mountains, as far east as Nova Scotia and Florida. This turtle species is noted for its combative disposition when out of the water with its powerful beak-like jaws, and highly mobile head and neck (hence the specific name serpentina, meaning “snake-like”). In water, they are likely to flee and hide themselves underwater in sediment.

This specimen was donated to the Nature Lab by Whitefoord Russell Cole III

Accession number: 121.23

Captured by Vija Lietuvninkas (MID '25) and Elise Williams (Sculpture '25) with an Artec Spider 3D Scanner https://www.artec3d.com/portable-3d-scanners/artec-spider-v2

name: Bugatti Circuit 2017 layout
description:
The Bugatti Circuit is a permanent race track located within the legendary Circuit des 24 Heures and named after Ettore Bugatti.

Due to the age and condition of Autodrome de Linas-Montlhéry, a search was conducted in the early 1960s for a location for a permanent race circuit and test track. Eventually the idea of using the section of the Le Mans 24 hour circuit that did not use public roads was hit upon. A plan for a 4.4 km permanent circuit was created, using the pit straight and first corner of the circuit, and looping back through various campgrounds and parking lots of the property. The track opened in 1965, having taken only a few months to construct. The original layout was 4.430 km long.

name: WrestleMania 37 Remastered Stage Design
description:
This project is a fan-made 3D recreation inspired by the stage design of WrestleMania 37, one of the biggest annual professional wrestling events organized by WWE.

The stage was modeled in Autodesk Maya with the goal of capturing the large-scale spectacle and themed environment of a WrestleMania arena entrance stage.

The design takes inspiration from the pirate-themed stage concept used at WrestleMania 37, featuring elements such as a large entrance structure, LED display areas, stage platforms, and a long entrance ramp designed for wrestler entrances during the event.

This project focuses on 3D environment creation and live event stage design, demonstrating how large arena stages can be built and visualized in a real-time 3D environment.

🔧 Software Used
Autodesk Maya – modeling and scene layout
📦 File Format
FBX
🎯 Possible Uses :
Game environment design

description:
Model 3D ini menampilkan struktur utama Rumah Tinggal Bertingkat Tipe 95 yang digunakan sebagai media pembelajaran pada mata pelajaran Estimasi Biaya Konstruksi. Model mencakup elemen-elemen struktur bangunan mulai dari pondasi hingga rangka atap, yaitu pondasi batu kali, footplate, sloof, kolom, balok, plat lantai, dinding, ring balok, tangga, serta rangka atap.

Setiap komponen struktur dirancang untuk memperlihatkan hubungan antar elemen dalam sistem konstruksi bangunan bertingkat serta fungsi masing-masing elemen dalam menyalurkan beban bangunan secara aman menuju tanah dasar. Model ini juga dilengkapi dengan informasi dan anotasi yang dapat membantu pengguna memahami fungsi, karakteristik, serta dasar perhitungan volume pekerjaan konstruksi.

Model dikembangkan sebagai bagian dari media pembelajaran berbasis Augmented Reality (AR) untuk mendukung pemahaman peserta didik terhadap struktur bangunan dan proses estimasi biaya konstruksi secara visual, interaktif, dan kontekstual.

You can easily edit the curve to change the shape of the light strip or create a completely new curve and apply the same geometry node system.

description:
**ESP** Capitel doble figurado románico (s. XII) procedente del claustro de la Colegiata de Santa Juliana de Santillana del Mar (Cantabria, España). Representa el conocido pasaje del Antiguo Testamento del profeta Daniel en el pozo de los leones, mientras que el lado orientado al interior de la galería dle claustro podría representar el Sueño de Nabucodosor.

It depicts the well-known passage from the Old Testament about the prophet Daniel in the lions' den, while the side facing the interior of the cloister gallery could represent Nebuchadnezzar's dream.

name: Whale Skeleton - Bake Kujira
description:
3D model of a whale skeleton, based on the traditional japanese horror story about the yokai named Bake Kujira.

name: sofa_lshape
description:
A high-quality, game-ready sofa designed for real-time applications such as video games, architectural visualization, and interactive environments. The model features optimized topology with efficient edge flow, ensuring strong performance without compromising visual fidelity.

The asset is built using a physically based rendering (PBR) workflow, including detailed textures for albedo, normal, roughness, and ambient occlusion. Subtle fabric patterns, stitching details, and realistic cushioning enhance the overall authenticity of the piece.

Carefully unwrapped UVs maximize texture resolution while minimizing seams, making it suitable for both close-up shots and background placement. The sofa is fully optimized for modern game engines like Unity and Unreal Engine, with a balanced polygon count and clean geometry.

Ideal for interior scenes, living room setups, and modern environments, this asset combines realism and performance, making it production-ready for professional use.

name: Qantara pyramidion
description:
# **Qantara Pyramidion
   
This object was discovered at the end of the 19th century at the site known as Tell Abu Seifi in Qantara. It was found in two pieces, which were later joined together. Initially, it was transferred to the Port Said Museum, then moved to the Ismailia Museum, where it was displayed in the garden. Eventually, it was relocated to the Suez Canal Museum in Ismailia.

The pyramidion originally stood inside the Temple of Horus, lord of Mesen, the eastern frontier city of Qantara. It was dedicated by Ramesses II. Based on the evidence, this city appears to have been located at Tell Abu Seifi in eastern Qantara. Ongoing excavations at the eastern frontier sites in Sinai are expected to reveal the lost city of Mesen soon.

name: Mammoth Tusk, T1. Cerney Wick 2025
description:
Mammoth Tusk found during the 2025 excavations of the ice age  (200,000+ years ago) site at Cerney Wick, Gloucestershire, UK.

This tusk measures 2.3 metres long in the extent shown here, the tip of the tusk was missing. A mammoth skull fragment was found in association with the tusk and had been lifted previously. This is the tusk from Trench 1, named by some "Hamish" after the person who found it ;-) . Initial indentification suggests it is from a Steppe Mammoth.

I quickly photographed for this model as the tusk and the ground around it was being prepared for plaster jacketing in order to lift it.

Photographed: 1 August 2025
Model built using Agisoft Metashape 2.2.1 (Standard edition)

Gymnogyps californianus, is a New World vulture and the largest North American land bird. It became extinct in the wild in 1987 when all remaining wild individuals were captured, but has since been reintroduced to northern Arizona and southern Utah (including the Grand Canyon area and Zion National Park), the coastal mountains of California, and northern Baja California in Mexico. It is the only surviving member of the genus Gymnogyps, although four extinct members of the genus are also known. The species is listed by IUCN as critically endangered, and similarly considered Critically Imperiled by NatureServe.[5]

name: Ammonite - Hildoceras sp.
description:
**Nom** : *Hildoceras sp.*

**Descrition** : Les ammonites pyriteuses sont le résultat d’un processus de fossilisation inhabituel : la pyritisation. Ce phénomène se produit lorsque les sédiments environnants sont pauvres en oxygène, créant un environnement anoxique favorable à la formation de pyrite (FeS₂) autour et dans les coquilles fossiles. Dans ce milieu, la matière organique se décompose lentement, permettant aux minéraux ferreux présents dans les eaux de sédimentation de remplacer la coquille d’origine, formant ainsi un moulage en pyrite.

**Dimensions** : 4,1 cm x 3,5 cm x 1,4 cm.

**Âge** : Toarcien, Jurassique inférieur.

**Localité** : inconnue.

**Méthode** : Acquisition de 509 photos avec Appareil Reflexe APS-C dans Studio Photos. Balance des blancs et colorimétrie par CaptureOne et Colorchecker. Modèle reconstruit par photogrammétrie.

name: Elysa Fraser mausoleum, Cluny, Scotland
description:
Elyza Fraser (1736–1814), owner of Castle Fraser, was an independent and cultured Aberdeenshire landowner whose life was shaped by both privilege and loss. Born Elizabeth Fraser, youngest child of Charles Fraser of Inverallochy and Ann Udny, she was known as Elyza after an elder sister of the same name died in infancy. Her family suffered deeply in the Jacobite rising and later imperial wars, with two brothers killed at Culloden and Quebec.

Her mausoleum and tomb commemorate a woman remembered for intellect, refinement, determination and duty, and form an important physical link to one of Castle Fraser’s most influential female lairds.  

This tomb within the Elysa Fraser mausoleum commemorates Frederick MacKenzie Fraser born on 4 April 1831, in Cluny. He married Marie Augusta Gabrielle Berengere Blanche Drummond on 24 April 1871, in Argyll, Scotland. He died on 19 May 1897, in Castle Fraser, Cluny, Aberdeenshire, Scotland, at the age of 66.

name: Etruscan seal (left humerus)
description:
3D scan of the left humerus of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: DAE Diorama - By The Ocean
description:
# An old lighthouse in Scotland is in the final days of its service.
This morning, the calm splashing of the sea was interrupted by an unannounced helicopter flight. Are they finally coming to decommission the lighthouse? The old lighthouse keeper hopes it's just a supply helicopter - he would dearly miss the little island and his seagull friends. 

---
This is a diorama for the 3D1 Course at Digital Arts and Entertainment Howest.

Final grade was 20/20 points.

---
Since uploading, I've discovered that some of the seagull poses didn't export properly. Rather funnily, the seagull at the top of the lighthouse now has a rod running through his head. I may do a reupload after grading is finished.

name: Ogden Laundry Building
description: Built in 1913, the Ogden Block has has been the home to many in its 110 year history. For the first few years of the buildings existence the Hong Lee Laundry operated out of the storefront while also serving as a boarding house for Chinese immigrants. From around 1916-1918 the building may have been used by the Ogden Military Convalescent Hospital, housing injured and disabled veterans. From 1922 until 2021 the building had switched owners over a dozen times, seeing use as a family home and as a rental property. In 2021 the City of Calgary purchased the building, and although the Ogden Block has cultural and historical value, it does not meet the requirements to be a protected. As a consequence, it is set to be demolished to make way for the proposed Green Line Transit System.

name: Rambi the Rhino – Donkey Kong Country
description:
Fan sculpt of Rambi the Rhino from the original Donkey Kong Country (1994).
My goal was to recreate the look of the old CGI render style from Rare’s pre-rendered era, staying true to the chunky forms, soft lighting, and plastic-like shading typical of that time.

Sculpted and polypainted in Blender, aiming to capture the expressive and toy-like feel of the SNES promotional models rather than the in-game low-poly.
No retopo, no PBR — just pure 90s charm. 🦏💾

* Victorious: Bazzi turns to his right, swings his arms while whistling, then jumps to face his left and repeats.
* Surprised: Bazzi jumps in a stiff pose, then poses defensively as he lands.
* Amused: Bazzi turns away and laughs into both of his hands, briefly facing forward before turning away again and laughing some more.
* Affectionate: Bazzi twirls around and attempts to blow a kiss.
* Showboat: Bazzi holds his hands out with a "ta-da!", then adjusts his bow tie (if in his Boom Hill outfit), or gives a quick salute (if wearing any other outfit).
* Sad: (standing) Bazzi falls forward and sobs with his face against the ground, creating a puddle of tears. (sitting) Bazzi cries for a moment, then blows his nose on his hands.
* Bored: (standing) Bazzi rolls his eyes, scratches his stomach, then pulls out a sandwich and takes a bite of it. (sitting) Bazzi falls asleep leaning back in his kart as "Zzz" and frogs appear above him.

description:
My attempt at a scientifically accurate Tyrannosaurus Rex.
The model was made for a game project. A lot of reference was taken from scientific papers, documentaries and some games. (notably Saurian)
A lot of the difficulties of this model came down to unknowns. There is still a lot of speculation when it comes to the appearance of the dinosaurs.
I had to make some choices where no scientific consensus was present. Still there are probably innacuracies but I am pretty happy with how it all turned out.
I got to spend a lot of time on the retopology to really get it game ready. I worked closely with our teams animator and rigger @Niceul , check her out! (she rigged this beast)

name: Bear-Shaped Pig
description:
# Woodcarving Collection
### Bear-Shaped Pig

> * Beech wood
> * Linseed oil finish
> * Completed on 20th July 2025

I started this wanting to carve a simple cat, but early on it was clear that I picked an overly thick piece of wood. I tried to turn it into a pig, but it seems like the wood was too thick for that too. The wide body and rounded legs make it look more like a bear from every side, other than the one initially shown on the 3D model, where it vaguely resembles a pig. 

It isn't great, but I hope that, in a few years, it'll be a good indicator of how far I've come with my carving skills.


**Shot with Autogrammetry v1.0**

description: Parasaurolophus was a large, herbivorous dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, around 76 to 73 million years ago. It belonged to the hadrosaur family, often called "duck-billed dinosaurs." Parasaurolophus is most famous for its long, backward-curving cranial crest, which may have been used for communication, display, and possibly thermoregulation. It could reach lengths of up to 10 meters (33 feet) and likely roamed in herds, feeding on plants and moving between forested and open environments. Fossils of Parasaurolophus have been found in North America, particularly in regions of Canada and the United States.

name: ⚠️ Your 3D Art May Be at Risk ⚠️
description:
To all artists, creators, and collectors on Sketchfab:

This post is intended to raise awareness about a risk that affects 3D content shared online. Some model-extraction and graphics-capture tools can be used to obtain geometry and textures from content that is rendered on a user's device. As a result, even models that are intended primarily for viewing may be vulnerable to unauthorized copying.

Many creators invest countless hours, days, or even months into producing high-quality 3D artwork. Unauthorized extraction, redistribution, or commercial use of these works can undermine that effort and harm the artists who make this community possible.

Please respect creators' intellectual property, licensing terms, and permissions. If you discover unauthorized copies of your work, consider reporting them through the appropriate channels and documenting the infringement.

The purpose of this message is to encourage awareness, discussion, and better protection of digital artwork within the Sketchfab community.

name: 3IR The Fluffy on Her Tower
description:
Name: 3IR (pronounced: air)

Gender: Female

Species: Cat (metamorphosed)

3IR the Fluffy wasn't born, she was forged. Unwilling to take the oppression of the Atlantean Army, 3IR went the way of the phoenix. 3IR knew that being soft and gentle gave her power to rival  the strongest armor. Rising from ashes, she became the cat she is now. It's what kept her alive.

This model and the woman who inspired it are important. She helped me through the hardest part of my life, then joined me for the greatest part.

CR4YCR4Y was made to accompany another character, based on someone I don't anymore. [My previous upload](https://skfb.ly/pux9o) depicts how I lived after being ejected from their life and home.

name: Терраса - 2 Ян, Алексей. С лесенкой.
description: Терраса NestoDom с лесенкой  — это современное архитектурное решение в формате пристройки примыкающей к дому, со ступенями из ЛСТК для спуска на газон, сочетающее в себе капитальную надежность и технологичность сборки. Несущий каркас выполнен на базе массивных опор-колонн из стальной профильной трубы проектного сечения (черный металл), что гарантирует максимальную устойчивость конструкции. Поверх силового основания монтируется высокоточная система из оцинкованного ЛСТК-профиля, разработанная специально для самостоятельной сборки без применения сварки. Оптимизированный шаг ферм в 600 мм обеспечивает идеальную плоскость и надежную опору для последующего монтажа террасной доски, а заводское качество всех элементов гарантирует долговечность и четкую геометрию пристройки на десятилетия.

name: Beaver
description: Beavers (genus Castor) are large semiaquatic rodents of the Northern Hemisphere. There are two extant species: the North American beaver (Castor canadensis) and the Eurasian beaver (C. fiber). Beavers are the second-largest living rodents, after capybaras, weighing up to 50 kg (110 lb). They have stout bodies with large heads, long chisel-like incisors, brown or gray fur, hand-like front feet, webbed back feet, and tails that are flat and scaly. The two species differ in skull and tail shape and fur color. Beavers can be found in a number of freshwater habitats, such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds. They are herbivorous, consuming tree bark, aquatic plants, grasses and sedges.

name: Minotaur
description:
from The Elder Scrolls IV Oblivion
The Minotaur (from Greek Μινώταυρος [Minótauros]) is a monster from Greek mythology, with the body of a man and the head of a bull. His name means "Bull of Minos", and he was the son of Pasiphae and the Bull of Crete. He was imprisoned in a labyrinth designed by the craftsman Daedalus, made expressly to retain him located in the city of Knossos on the island of Crete. For many years, seven men and seven other women were taken to the labyrinth as a sacrifice to be the beast's food, until its life ended at the hands of the hero Theseus. The fourteen young people were interned in the labyrinth, where they wandered lost until they were found by the Minotaur. The myth has its most complete version in the Mythological Library of Apollodorus.

name: Plaza de Armas Osorno
description:
La Plaza de Armas de Osorno nació en 1558 como el núcleo político de la ciudad. Tras la refundación de 1793, se consolidó como el centro neurálgico local. En la década de 1930, el paisajista Óscar Prager la modernizó con un diseño de estilo modernista, ejes en cruz y su icónico espejo de agua central. Hoy destaca como uno de los paseos públicos más verdes de Chile.

Modelo con fines académicos de la asignatura Laboratorio Digital Multimedia del tercer semestre de la carrera Diseño Digital Profesional Osorno, dirigido por el docente Marco Barría. Modelo Creado por Mateo Shibar y Tiffany Frendo.

name: Mid-Century Coastal Concrete Structure
description:
This 3D model represents a characteristic coastal concrete structure defined by a clear adaptation to uneven terrain. The design reflects a functional response to natural slope variations, where the supporting framework compensates for differences in elevation through a sequence of angular reinforcements and triangulated supports.
The mesh analysis reveals a deliberate distribution of load across inclined beams, emphasizing stability over ornamental detail. Subtle irregularities in the geometry suggest manual construction processes, typical of mid-20th century engineering practices, where precision was balanced with material limitations and on-site adjustments.

description:
The southern entrance gate to the Upper Belvedere is adorned with two lions as coat of arms holders. Prince Eugene's golden coat of arms is set in a cartouche, topped with a crown. Next to it is an upright lion.

The Belvedere is one of the most important Baroque palace complexes in Europe. It was built at the beginning of the 18th century by Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt for Prince Eugene of Savoy. The complex consists of the Upper and Lower Belvedere, which are connected by a spacious garden. Today, the palace houses the most important collection of Austrian art – from medieval panels to works by Gustav Klimt.

name: elephant
description:
from "farcry4"
The Asian elephant (Elephas maximus) is a species of proboscis mammal in the Elephantidae family. It is the largest mammal in Asia. Its original distribution extends from southern China and western Indonesia to the coasts of the Persian Gulf and southern Mesopotamia, where it disappeared in the Neolithic period. It is currently limited to Sri Lanka, southern and northeastern India, Bangladesh, Indochina, Malacca, Sumatra, and northeastern Borneo. It is found both in the wild and domesticated and is very common in zoos and circuses. It is considered an endangered species. The Indian elephant has been domesticated since ancient times in Southeast Asia for the purpose of carrying loads, assisting in construction (usually carrying and lifting beams), or transporting people. In times of war, it has also been used to carry weapons and artillery pieces.

name: Neoceratodus (lungfish) Reconstruction
description:
Is there such a thing as a 'living fossil'? No, that's an oxymoron, but ***Neoceratodus fosteri*** (the Australian/Queensland lungfish) comes close! The strange pronged tooth-plates of this animal are almost identical to species found in Cretaceous rocks - these have since also been assigned to the genus ***Neoceratodus***.

This 3D skeletal reconstruction was created by [Astrid O'Connor](https://www.instagram.com/palaeoastrid/) in Blender (v3.4) through a combination of segmenting and processing a whole-body lungfish CT scan (**AMI 49438** by **Jessie Maisano** on **Morphosource** [here](http://www.morphosource.org/concern/media/000115978?locale=en)) to create the ossified bones, modelling the fins from the amazing free cartilage pectoral fin model (specimen **MCZ 157044** by **@tomstewartscience** [here](http://skfb.ly/6RBPz)), and additional sculpting work.

This reconstruction also aknowledges the incredible lungfish research by **Alice Clement**.

Blue = cartilage, opaque = lung, bronze = teeth.
tags: skeleton, fish, Fossil, lungfish, blender3d, sarcopterygii, neoceratodus

name: Wall paintings in Hoxne church, Suffolk, UK
description: This is a fairly rough reconstruction of the wall paintings on the north wall of the church of St Peter and St Paul in Hoxne, Suffolk, UK. The photos were taken in August 2023. There is a lot wrong with the reconstruction -- the pews have gone awry, one column is floating baselessly, and so on. The light through the clerestory windows makes the paintings unclear, but they are unclear in reality as well. Really, the main point of this reconstruction is to give some context to better images of the wall paintings. I'll give some links in the comments. The photos were processed in RealityScan and tidied up in Meshlab.

name: farnsworth-house-glass-pavilion-v004-cityprompt
description:
A meticulously detailed, real-time ready 3D model of Mies van der Rohe's iconic Farnsworth House built in Blender. 

.glb asset is fully optimized for Three.js environments. The geometry features a highly organized node hierarchy with precise architectural naming for components like W8x48 steel columns and travertine terrace steps. It leverages advanced Khronos glTF extensions (KHR_materials_transmission, KHR_materials_ior) to deliver physically accurate glass refraction across the pavilion's signature curtain walls. The fully furnished interior includes authentic golden primavera wood core detailing and is illuminated by baked warm interior lighting (KHR_materials_emissive_strength), making it an ideal drop-in asset for high-fidelity urban planning or architectural renders.

name: Proyecto Monte Bello
description:
Modelo 3D Fotogramétrico de Terreno – Procesamiento UAV

Modelo tridimensional generado a partir de 154 imágenes aéreas capturadas con dron DJI Mini 3, mediante técnica de fotogrametría digital.

El procesamiento se realizó en Agisoft Metashape, siguiendo el flujo de trabajo:

Alineación de imágenes

Generación de nube de puntos densa

Construcción de malla (mesh)

Aplicación de textura

Generación de Modelo Digital de Terreno (MDT)

Extracción de curvas de nivel con intervalo de 0.5 m

El modelo permite la visualización detallada de la morfología del terreno y fue utilizado para análisis topográfico y representación altimétrica precisa.

Aplicaciones:

Análisis topográfico

Planificación territorial

Estudios preliminares de ingeniería

Generación de cartografía de detalle

name: Paurakirche - Church of the Holy Trinity
description:
The pilgrimage church of Stadl-Paura is located in the municipality of Stadl-Paura in Upper Austria. According to legend, Abbot Maximilian Pagl of Lambach Abbey vowed to have a church built if the plague spared Lambach. Since it was considered to have been eradicated on Christmas Day 1713, the abbot requested permission to build the chapel in a letter dated January 2, 1714, in order to fulfill his promise. 

The Church is considered the “Church of the Holy Trinity” because its entire architecture and furnishings are based on the symbolism of the number three: the floor plan is a circle within an equilateral triangle, with three towers at the corners housing the sacristy, confessional, and St. Mary's Chapel, three entrances with three altars opposite each other, and three organs. The triangular lantern on the dome also emphasizes this concept, so that the building visibly refers to the Trinity in every form.

Captured in 336 images using a Dji mini 4, processed with RealityCapture and edited in Blender.

name: Archeologische opgraving - Metiusgracht
description:
Tijdens archeologisch onderzoek in oktober 2024 bij de Metiusgracht, achter het Noordwest Ziekenhuis in Alkmaar, zijn sporen gevonden van bebouwing en gebruik van dit terrein. Het onderzoek maakt deel uit van de herinrichting van de Alkmaarder Hout, waarbij het voormalige parkeer- en helikopterterrein teruggegeven wordt aan het stadspark. Dit 3D-model toont één van de opgegraven structuren in detail en kan vrij bekeken worden in VR en AR.

**Technische details**

Fotogrammetrie met **DJI Mini 4 Pro** en **Sony A7RIII**

Modellering en publicatie door de **Gemeente Alkmaar – Vakgroep Erfgoed**
